problem_statement: The NAT64 translator tracks per-protocol packet and byte counters for each address mapping, exposed through the translator's protocol-counter type. The unit test constructs an expected counter object (e.g. one UDP 6-to-4 packet, 12 bytes, in both the per-protocol and the total groups) and compares it against the counter object read back from an address-mapping iterator using the equality operator (`AsCoreType(&mapping.mCounters) == expectedCounters`). The translator's protocol-counter type does not define an equality operator, so any code that compares two such counter objects does not compile. The required behavior is that the translator's protocol-counter objects support equality comparison so observed counters can be checked against expected ones.
